name: Modifies Roll
description: Lets the wearer forgo rolling a d20 for a specific kind of roll and take a fixed result instead.

mechanics.text: Instead of rolling the d20 for this record's own featureParams.rollType, the user can take featureParams.value on the die. Distinct from feat.reroll-save (rolls again) and a flat bonus (adds to whatever's rolled) — this replaces the roll outright.
